title: Two Days to Open the Sea

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: talks on a two-day plan to reopen Hormuz, but riots in Frankfurt, a court standoff in Poland and a record crypto heist. Evacuees from Oleshky reunite with family, and astronomers spot a possible dwarf planet beyond Pluto.

style.genre: minimal EBM — harpsichord, pizzicato strings, celesta, TR-606

lines: Two days, they say, to open the sea,
a plan passed hand to hand,
in Frankfurt glass across the street,
A bus pulls in from Oleshky,
and past the cold edge of Pluto
a small world finds its place.
the calm is thin as wire,
